title: Iron Rift FPS
observed_goal: No active game goal was observed in the available frame; the available evidence is inconclusive. The loading-page text claims that the game is about killing quickly and stylishly, but game execution was not observed to verify this goal.
observed_controls: not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; controls_attempted is empty in the metadata and no accepted input has been confirmed.
observed_core_loop: The core game loop was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. Only the loading screen was seen, and no repeated movement, engagement, progression, or outcome loop is present in the frames.
progress_feedback: The screenshot shows a progress bar with the text BUILDING ARENA and a value of 44%. The metadata stage_text also records 20% for the load frame and READY/100% texts for after_combined_input, but frames from those stages are unavailable; therefore, the only direct feedback is loading progress.
decisions_risk_reward: Decisions, risk/reward, and in-game choices were not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. The official card text discusses game style and upgrades, but these elements were not playtested.
rewards: Actual rewards were not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. The official card refers to style meter and combat augments, but these claims were not confirmed through game execution.
penalties_failure: Penalties, failure, vulnerability, or loss conditions were not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
outcomes_replay: Outcome, win/loss, wave ending, or replayability was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. No complete loop or direct outcome was recorded.
onboarding: The only observed onboarding is the loading screen titled IRON RIFT ONSLAUGHT with the status BUILDING ARENA. No control instructions or tutorial are visible; the official card text refers to broad content, not confirmed onboarding.
visual_audio_accessibility: Visually, the screenshot shows a dark loading screen with a centered title, an orange progress bar, and a very blurred background. Audio was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive; the metadata records a technical warning that AudioContext without user gesture is not permitted. Accessibility features were not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
technical_clues: The page was recorded with HTTP 200 and loaded status; this is only a page-loading clue and does not establish that the game loop is active.
Two canvases with dimensions 1280×800 are recorded in the metadata; this is a possible technical rendering clue, not proof of successful interaction.
A fallback warning to software WebGL and a GPU stall in ReadPixels were recorded; these are possible technical clues about the rendering/performance path.

AudioContext without user gesture was not permitted, and several 403 errors, one 400 error, and a remote config error were recorded; their precise effect on the game was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
transferable_principles: Keep loading or preparation progress distinct from actual execution using simple, recognizable visual feedback.
For an action game, the basic loop should be evaluated with direct, repeatable evidence of action, system response, and outcome, not advertising copy.
Any claim about skill, rewards, or upgrades should be observable and testable in the actual interface and execution.
If interaction depends on user gesture or a specific rendering path, technical errors and readiness status should be reported transparently.
candle_climber_relevance: For Candle Climber, each score/rank should reflect only skill and performance; this input provided no evidence about the game's scoring model.
No purchase- or wallet-derived advantage should enter the design; this is a transferable design principle and was not tested in this game.
free brake, horizontal direction change, or a branch path requiring new control should not be proposed as a result of this review; each could only be a hypothesis requiring separate testing.
do_not_copy: Do not reproduce this game's name, text, visual identity, scene, or assets.
Do not copy the official card's claims about waves, enemies, weapons, movement, or boss as confirmed features.
Do not treat a possible frame change or progress value by itself as evidence of input acceptance or game execution.
Do not infer from the absence of game elements in the opening frame that they are absent from the game as a whole.

evidence.claim: The available frame shows the Iron Rift: Onslaught loading screen with the title and status BUILDING ARENA.
The screenshot shows a loading progress bar with a value of 44%.
The recorded page text for load includes «Kill fast and stylishly» and references headshots, slide kills, air kills, weapon swaps, and style meter.

The official game card describes it as including eight escalating waves, weapons, aggressive movement, combat augments, Overdrive, a three-phase boss, and deathmatch with five bots; these elements were not confirmed through game execution.
The metadata records two canvases with dimensions 1280×800 and warnings for software WebGL, GPU stall, and AudioContext without user gesture.
No controls_attempted, start_action, or completed frame was recorded for after_start, after_key_burst, after_combined_input, or late, and a frame change by itself does not prove input acceptance.

limitations: This analysis uses only evidence.json and the load frame. Only the load stage was completed; frames from the other stages are unavailable and several screenshots timed out. No game controls, active execution, complete loop, outcome, audio, or accessibility were confirmed. The 44% value in the screenshot differs from the 20% value in the stage_text metadata and was reported as two separate observations; the reason for the discrepancy was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
